summary: Primary-source review through 2026-11-21 08:30 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh found no new verified AI-specific employment evidence materially changing Career Radar since 2026-11-20. BLS Nov 20 state employment and total factor productivity releases are observed labor/productivity statistics, not causal evidence of AI-driven displacement. Existing BLS payroll, OECD/ILO exposure and IMF job-postings evidence are not duplicated. OECD Nov 17 work-organisation research was submitted Nov 19 but rejected; requires separate operational remediation, not duplicate ingestion. Employment/payroll, postings, exposure, adoption, forecasts and causal inference remain distinct.
